title: Hard Way, The Only Way: Provable Merits of Training on Hardest Examples
abstract: arXiv:2610.21201v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite a surge of empirical interest in the ``unreasonable effectiveness'' of drastic data pruning for AI systems, a unified theoretical understanding of this phenomenon remains elusive. In this work, we provide a precise high-dimensional theory of learning under data pruning via weighted empirical risk minimization (ERM). As in previous work, we analyze a setting where pruning is performed along a one-dimensional subspace of the input space. Our analysis precisely characterizes the limiting test error curves in the regime where the input dimension N and sample size P tend to infinity with a fixed ratio N/P. The resulting theory recovers several recent results in the literature as special cases and provides a general lens to evaluate how pruning strategies interact with the loss function and label noise. translated_title: 艰难之路，唯一之路：在最难样本上训练的可证明优势
translated_abstract: 尽管人们对AI系统中激进数据剪枝的“不合理有效性”产生了大量实证研究兴趣，但对这一现象的统一理论理解仍然缺失。在本工作中，我们通过加权经验风险最小化（ERM）为数据剪枝下的学习提供了一个精确的高维理论。与先前工作类似，我们分析了沿输入空间一维子空间进行剪枝的设定。我们的分析精确刻画了在输入维度N与样本量P以固定比值N/P趋于无穷大的渐近极限下测试误差曲线的极限形态。所得理论将文献中近期的若干结果作为特例加以恢复，并为评估剪枝策略与损失函数及标签噪声之间的相互作用提供了一个通用视角。尤为关键的是，我们刻画了在样本充足（P远大于N）情形下的最优剪枝策略。我们证明了……
tldr: 该论文通过加权经验风险最小化建立了数据剪枝的精确高维理论，并证明在样本量远超维度的情形下，仅保留最难样本进行训练是可证明的最优剪枝策略。
